name: pitboss
description: The pitboss plugin: a sweep of a project's pull requests, merge queue, local checkouts and worker slots.

plugins.name: pitboss
plugins.description: The sweep skill: run 'uvx pitboss sweep <config>' to see every open PR's state, runner pressure, stale merge-queue runs, unpushed work and stale worktrees, and what each calls for; keep the worker-slot ledger and get the sorted list of what to start next.
